API platform does not train on inputs/outputs by default (opt-in to share). Consumer ChatGPT is a different product and may train unless opted out. No public API text-watermark disclosure.

Paid Gemini API is not used for training; unpaid/consumer surfaces are less clear so retention is opt-out (strictest ambiguous reading). Google documents SynthID watermarking for generated media; treat watermark as always for sensitive-ip until a text-specific exclusion is confirmed.
Cursor Privacy Mode / data-sharing controls are account settings, not a hard API none. Strictest reading: opt-out. No public output-watermark disclosure.
OpenCode is a local CLI that forwards to the user's configured providers. Privacy follows the backing provider; seed uses opt-out until a provider-specific row overrides it.
Local inference. No vendor training retention or watermark when the runtime stays on-device.
